Vox Emphasis Animator
Say it louder.
Drop text on the canvas, then circle it, rule it, or highlight it — the pen draws itself.
Three ways to insist
Circle the claim.
Rule the line.
Highlight the point.
One element, one mark, one clock — the words land first, the pen follows.
The circle
Perfect oval, or pen loops.
perfect ovalorganic wobblemessy scribbledouble loopsingle overlap
Four pen presets — wobble from 0.0 to 0.25, passes from 1.0 to 3.5.
The highlighter
Loud on purpose.
standard yellowbright greenelectric cyanneon pink
Opacity is a slider, not a decision — .7 is where the mock starts.
The stroke scale
Thin for asides. Thick for absolutes.
Two pixels to twelve — draw duration, loops and passes, drawn backwards on demand.
